sources.quote: Epictetus spent a portion of his life as the slave of Epaphroditus ... Eventually receiving his freedom, he began lecturing on his own account

claims.text: các nhà nghiên cứu vẫn chỉ ra dấu vết của Khắc kỷ trong những liệu pháp nhận thức hiện đại, như công trình của Albert Ellis

sources.quote: The Modern Stoicism movement traces its roots to Victor Frankl’s (Sahakian 1979) logotherapy, as well as to early versions of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, for instance in the work of Albert Ellis (Robertson 2010).

claims.text: Epictetus không viết gì. Học trò ông là Arrian ghi lại bài giảng thành Diễn từ (Discourses), rồi rút gọn thành Cẩm nang vào đầu thế kỷ 2

sources.quote: It appears that Epictetus wrote nothing himself. The works we have that present his philosophy were written by his student, Flavius Arrian. We may conjecture that the Discourses and the Handbook were written some time around the years 104–107
The shorter Encheiridion (titled in English either Manual or Handbook) is a brief abridgment of the Discourses.
Epictetus wrote nothing; and all that we have under his name was written
